tmp:1494: gevanin ila'in — the 'supernal colors/hues' (Zoharic Aramaic term for the upper sefirotic lights), here identified with silver and gold
tmp:1495: kesef ve-zahav — silver and gold as a paired symbol: the physical embodiment of the supernal colors/hues resting on money
tmp:1496: ra'ah — 'the evil' unleashed from the north (Jeremiah 1:14), identified as anger (ka'as) descending from the Gevurot, twin of money/gold
tmp:1498: hastarat penei Hashem — the concealment of God's face caused by Israel's lack of faith/heresy, itself an expression of divine anger and wrath
tmp:1499: kefirah ba-avodah zarah — the denial/repudiation of idolatry, the trait embodied by Mordecai the 'ish Yehudi' (whoever denies idols is called a Yehudi)
tmp:1501: the principle 'when it (truth) dwells with you, He will illuminate you' — divine light dwells and shines according to the measure of one's truth, since God is the essence of truth
tmp:1503: hamtakat ha-charon af — the sweetening/mitigation of divine wrath, effected via 'potei'ach et yadekha' whose final letters spell ChaTaKh (= twice ruach), distinguishing right hand from left
tmp:1504: kasher/pasul, tamei/tahor, asur/mutar — the six paired halakhic categories (fit/unfit, impure/pure, forbidden/permitted) comprising the six orders of Mishnah, corresponding to the six weekdays and Metatron
tmp:1505: the act of shutting one's eyes and aiming one's gaze at the ultimate purpose (tachlit) — contracting physical sight amid suffering so as to focus on the distant final goal
tmp:1506: the practice of binding and elevating speech to its root (Imma/supernal Mother) — 'chariots of Pharaoh' read as tefillin-lights revealed from Imma
tmp:1507: learning Torah with another person — the act of teaching a fellow, classed as 'writing' since the tongue engraves words on the student's heart
tmp:1508: ketivah — writing as a category of Torah transmission: the tongue as 'the pen of a ready scribe' inscribing teaching on the tablet of the student's heart
tmp:1509: the letter kaf — the alphabet letter symbolizing Keter (Crown), the inner soul-dimension linked to the Shekhinah as nefesh
tmp:1510: 'that which orders and settles the intellect' — the faculty of arranging/composing the mind, identified as Keter (from kattar, 'to wait'), blessed by the inner dimension of the blessings
tmp:1512: seyag — the 'fence' around wisdom ('a fence for wisdom is silence'), identified as Keter, the encircling crown formed out of silence that surrounds Chokhmah
tmp:1514: shufra di-shufra — 'the beauty of beauty' (Zoharic term): the choicest illumination from the 32 (lamed-bet=lev) Elokim of Creation that nourishes and names the heart
tmp:1515: the Mishkan (Tabernacle) in its built state — corresponding to the 39 (lamed-tet/'tal') lights merited by guarding the brit
tmp:1516: lamed-tet orot — the thirty-nine ('tal', dew) lights, the illuminations preserved by one who guards the covenant (opposite of the 39 labors/lashes)
tmp:1517: the Mishkan (Tabernacle) in its destroyed state — corresponding to the 39 lashes (malkot), the punitive counterpart to the 39 lights (Tikkun 48)
tmp:1518: the counterfactual state 'had your brain(-drops) not been blemished' — i.e., if one's seminal/mind drops were intact, referring to pegam ha-brit in the mind
tmp:1519: the consequence 'you would not hear the quarrels between the tzaddikim' — hearing tzaddikim's disputes is a rebuke signaling one's own blemished mind-drops
tmp:1520: the state of having no distress on the road — safety in travel, contingent on shemirat ha-brit ('all roads are presumed dangerous'; hence visiting one's wife before a journey)
tmp:1521: the future messianic state 'no good will be lacking and all will be entirely good' — the era of 'ha-tov ve-ha-meitiv' when increased Da'at brings eternal life
tmp:1522: 'lo yitama' — the priestly prohibition against defiling oneself for a corpse (Lev 21), read as guarding the brit from sexual impurity, root of tum'ah
tmp:1523: 'lo avado' — 'one who does not serve Him' (Malachi 3:18), the type among the four who entered Pardes who ascends beyond his level and is stricken (Ben Azzai's hetzitz ve-nifga)
tmp:1524: the alephs in holiness — the holy aleph-letters identified with Leah, which when fallen become the opponents' weariness (hal'ot) and scorn of God-fearers
tmp:1526: korban olah — the burnt offering, which is in the aspect of Leah; the daily olat tamid sweetens her judgments against the impure 'worm' of the kelipah
tmp:1529: the act of swiftly expelling the ruach shetut (spirit of folly) from within oneself — accomplished by binding oneself in soul-love to the true tzaddik
tmp:1530: lev nishbar — the broken heart: the heart's contrite state connected with expelling the spirit of folly and being incorporated into the tzaddik's heart
tmp:1531: coming/gaining access to the true shepherds (ro'im) who are the collectivity (kelaliyut) of holiness — attainable only through holy boldness (azut, 'bold as a leopard')
tmp:1532: hitkarvut la-tzaddikim — drawing close to the tzaddikim and following the path of their counsel, whereby their advice engraves truth (emet) in a person
tmp:1533: coming/arriving at truth (emet) — the attainment of truth itself, possible only via closeness to tzaddikim and receiving their counsel (a union/zivug)
tmp:1534: the Torah that shines to people in the very place where they are — Torah-light reaching sinners and converts 'chutzah' (outward), via its 600,000 letters matching the 600,000 souls, to awaken teshuvah
tmp:1536: coming to bittul — attaining self-nullification (nullifying desires, bad traits, and corporeality to be included in one's root), possible only through hitbodedut
tmp:1537: attaining mochin zakkim — pure, clarified mental faculties (holiness/purity of thought), the prerequisite for sweetening judgments, sought by traveling to tzaddikim for Rosh HaShanah
tmp:1539: nullifying the body entirely — speaking Torah and prayer until the body becomes naught and one flesh with the speech ('ve-hayu le-vasar echad')
tmp:1540: hitbodedut practice — secluding oneself and pouring out one's conversation between oneself and one's Creator, the means to bittul
tmp:1542: nullifying the trait of nitzachon (contentiousness/winning) and machloket (dispute) and pursuing peace — the obligatory eradication of the blood-rooted urge to conquer
tmp:1545: levanah de-sitra achra — the 'moon of the Other Side': the demonic counterpart-moon of the wicked kingdom (malkhut ha-resha'ah), of which it says 'the moon will be ashamed' (Isaiah 24)
tmp:1546: banim — children/offspring: the merit of begetting sons, attained only through complete da'at (a minor cannot beget, lacking full da'at), as Abraham merited via making converts
